acceptance: Each worlds type is code in `types.py` (World and Policy as Protocols in `core.py`); each `tests/contracts/worlds.<Type>/` sample validates, and the World and Policy replay doubles serve their recordings
`new_snake`, `greedy_snake`, `play_episode`, `make_world`, `random_policy` and `time_steps` import with their signatures, each body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task>")`
The `worlds.make_world` and `worlds.baseline` fakes serve their fixtures; `__init__.py` exports the contract

Each learn type is code in `types.py`, plus the internal `Learner` and `Transition` in `protocols.py`; each `tests/contracts/learn.<Type>/` sample validates, and the RunDir and RunWriter replay doubles serve their recordings
`open_run`, `close_run`, `build_team`, `load_settings`, `run_loop`, `final_scores` and `evaluate` import with their signatures, plus `beats` in `verdicts.py`, each stub naming its task
The `learn.beats` and `learn.evaluate` replay doubles serve recorded verdicts and scores for lab's tests; `__init__.py` exports the contract
`Panel`, `Chart` and `ReplayResult` are code in `types.py`; each `tests/contracts/lab.<Type>/` sample validates
The cli steps of PL-15–PL-17, plus `draw_curve` and `play`, import with their signatures, each stub naming its task; `__init__.py` exports the contract
TC-01–TC-04 pass (eating, turns, wall, body versus vacated tail, hunger limit)
TC-05 passes (greedy baseline); TC-06 passes (compact view and full-view length)
`play_episode` runs the World replay double to `over` and returns its last StepResult; `make_world` and `baseline` look names up in their dicts (AD-03) and raise `ValueError` listing valid names
On the WorldSpec samples, `random_policy` returns valid actions for discrete and box spaces, the same ones for the same seed
`time_steps` on the World and Policy replay doubles returns a BenchResult with `steps_per_s == steps / seconds`
`open_run` writes `settings.toml`, `meta.json` and the CSV headers, flushing every row, and refuses an existing folder; TC-28 passes
`close_run` writes the `scores/` files and wall clock, and returns a RunDir that reads them back
`load_settings` parses a TOML file into RunSettings and names any unknown key; `build_team` gives a Team with the learner from its `kind` and fixed members from the `worlds.baseline` fake
On the World replay double and the Team sample, `run_loop` logs one row per episode, evaluates every `eval_every`, and saves s000–s100 through the RunWriter double, CPU only, from seeded generators
`evaluate` and `final_scores` play the Team sample, and its random and scripted variants, on `EVAL_SEEDS` with `explore=False`; two calls give identical EvalScores
On the RunDir and `learn.beats` replay doubles, each cli step returns a schema-valid output; `main` routes the subcommands and returns 2 on bad arguments
`draw_curve` on the RunDir double writes a PNG with the evaluation curve and one labelled line per baseline, styled with the `dataviz` skill, and returns a valid Chart

With the dummy video driver, `play` steps one panel of the World double, drawing each Scene sample with step and score text, and handles space and → keys; it runs at ≥ 30 frames per second, writes an MP4 when `video` is set (imageio, AD-09), and returns a valid ReplayResult
`python -m rllab.worlds rollout snake --seed 1 --smoke` runs end to end, committed as PL-07's smoke test; TC-07 passes for Snake (Tank and Hunt join in M3 and M5)
PL-07's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`python -m rllab.worlds bench --steps 1000 --smoke` runs end to end, committed as PL-10's smoke test; TC-20 passes for Snake as a `perf` test
PL-10's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`learn.train` on `configs/smoke/chain2-qtable.toml` runs end to end against the `worlds.make_world` fake, committed as PL-11's smoke test
TC-25, TC-26 and TC-29 pass; PL-11's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
verify: pytest tests/intent/learn -k "run_folder or interrupted or deterministic"

acceptance: `rllab train configs/smoke/chain2-qtable.toml --seed 1 --smoke` trains, then writes the learning-curve PNG; committed as PL-15's smoke test; pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer

`rllab eval <smoke run> --smoke` prints a verdict table and writes `scores/verdicts.json`, using the `learn.beats` replay double; committed as PL-16's smoke test; pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer

`rllab replay <smoke run> --snapshots 0,100 --seed 1 --no-window --video /tmp/x.mp4 --smoke` plays the two snapshots headless, one after the other (side by side arrives in M3), writes the MP4 and returns a ReplayResult; committed as PL-17's smoke test; pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer

nodes.title: Lookup-table Q-values match the chain's exact values

acceptance: TC-21 passes: on the test-only `chain2` world, every lookup-table entry is within 1% of Q*; the learner uses basic array operations only (VALUE-01)
TC-37 passes (planted gap passes); TC-38 passes (pure noise: ≤ 1 of 20 seeds passes)
TC-39 passes (identical scores: not passed, p 1.0); the Verdict records the statistic and correction
`rllab train configs/snake/qtable.toml --seed 1` runs on the real Snake world and lookup table; TC-34 passes (marked `slow`)
`rllab eval runs/snake/qtable` prints real `learn.beats` verdicts, and the lookup table passes against random play
Headless replay of that run's s100 on evaluation seed 1,000,003 ends with that seed's evaluation score (REPLAY-05)
